title: Rainbow Tree
body:
Description

The Rainbow Tree is a tree added during the 2025 April Fools update, and was removed 7 days later. The tree requires dynamite to cut it down. It can prove to be a challenge to gather as its gravity is inverted. The only way to make the gravity of the wood normal is to plank it, however the wood loses it's rainbow color when sanded or planked and turns white.

Trivia

  • This tree was available from 4/1/2025 Until 4/7/2025.
  • It is impossible to cut this tree with any axe, you must use dynamite to cut it down.
  • The tree's Gravity is inverted to regular Trees
